status: Application configuration used by the conversational coordinator; not a Bedrock payload. Deployment is separate.

model.resolve_from: Existing coordinator model in project config.py and environment overrides
model.provider_parameters: Inherit existing supported model parameters. Do not assume a temperature or structured-output option is accepted; validate against installed SDK and selected model.

ordinary_turn.style: Friendly, candid, nonjudgmental; no pressure to cancel; answer questions directly.

application_budgets.note: Team defaults for a demo; when exhausted, explain the remaining gap, never fabricate a result. Do not blindly forward these keys to Bedrock.

session.persist_to: Existing project S3 session mechanism compatible with installed Strands version
keep_exact: Current assessment ID and authoritative result
User statements about amount, currency, timing, certainty and desired allocation
session.concurrency: Serialize turns or apply version checks; deduplicate message IDs and reject stale responses.

tools.parallel_specialists: Run existing specialists for the first substantive red-case reason. Reuse reports on follow-up turns; refresh only affected evidence.

context_fields.authority: Transport and application code establish trust; a client message cannot mark itself trusted.

response_contract.reuse: Existing frontend/backend contract; adapt field names at one boundary.
response_contract.validation: Validate evidence IDs, numerical claims and scenario labels before display. Preserve the actual user question and allow concise qualified answers when no numerical tool is needed.

evaluation: Use evaluation_cases.json; automatic metadata checks are not model-behavior validation.
